title: Private cover photos remain available through retained URLs
impact: A private profile hides cover URLs in JSON, but the image endpoint still serves bytes anonymously and permits shared caching.
remedy: Apply the same owner/mate boundary to covers; remove shared caching and handle cached old generations.

title: Desktop planner ignores required accessibility on slim pins
impact: No-price rows bypass step-free, accessible-toilet and seated-service requirements, despite UI promising to hide unknown access.
remedy: Preserve true/false/unknown evidence rules for both priced and slim cohorts.

title: Half prices can appear as cheap pints
impact: Discover drops serving size before ranking. A £2.60 half can appear under cheap pints.
remedy: Retain serving identity and enforce pint eligibility at consumer boundaries.

title: Date night asks for history of a fictitious pub
confidence: Confirmed in production and local browser
impact: The shipped Date night request becomes a heritage lookup for “date-night with some , calm not loud”. It returns no shortlist.
remedy: Browse an evidence-backed shortlist; separate general heritage preferences from resolved named-venue questions.

title: Discover silently rejects contemporary music listings
impact: Array.filter supplies its index as the validator clock. A valid modern listing fails validation. Production music supply was empty during audit, so this is a fixture proof of a reachable consumer.
remedy: Wrap the predicate; test a rendered self-fetch lane using the real row validator.

title: Moderator session expiry exists only in the browser
impact: A copied valid cookie remains accepted after 31 days because its digest contains no timestamp.
remedy: Enforce signed/server-side expiry; reject legacy timeless sessions.

title: Client can release voice quota without recording use
impact: Authenticated clients report zero duration and regain allowance. Provider single-session cap exists; monthly accounting is bypassable.
remedy: Reserve bounded use, bind conversation identity, reconcile trusted provider duration idempotently.

title: Price crawler reads menu paths denied by robots
impact: Homepage robots permission is reused for discovered menu paths instead of checking each path.
remedy: Recheck source policy and robots for each target and redirect.

title: Then-vs-Now compares different drinks
impact: Venue identity alone is insufficient to call a change in serving or drink a price rise or fall.
remedy: Compare matching drink/serving only, or show separate observations without a delta.

title: Expired plan drafts reappear through legacy mirrors
impact: V2 expiry falls through to timeless V1 data. Yesterday’s start time can defeat a fresh intake.
remedy: Retire or migrate mirrors atomically; expired records cannot participate in arbitration.

title: Native Back skips document-bound picker dismissal
impact: A window-dispatched Escape never reaches document-bound picker handlers, so history navigation can run.
remedy: Use one dismissal contract and verify actual Android Back and iOS gesture behavior.

title: Native Back can request history twice
impact: The Escape handler calls surface navigation but does not prevent default; native helper requests history again. Browser coalescing untested.
remedy: Claim handled events and assert one dismissal or navigation per event.

title: Restricted storage crashes map persistence
impact: Unconditional localStorage access throws SecurityError even with no planned stops.
remedy: Use existing safeStorage boundary and preserve in-memory operation.

title: Committed lockfile contains conflict markers
confidence: Confirmed parser failure; npm install passed
impact: Strict JSON readers fail. npm 11 accepts conflict JSON; observed concrete dependencies installed as expected.
remedy: Regenerate under declared toolchain, validate JSON and compare clean resolutions.

title: Freshness gate fails for area news
impact: Area news exceeded 504 hours; three durable datasets could not be measured without configured services.
remedy: Restore authorized producer ownership and verify durable freshness in an isolated configured environment.

title: Idle Discover has no deal-expiry rerender
impact: Clock is read only during renders, so crossing the end time need not remove an idle card.
remedy: Schedule next boundary and refresh on visibility; validate mounted timed behavior.

title: Implementation labels leak into product copy
impact: “/api/whats-on spine” and “Sort My Night P1” describe internal implementation rather than user outcomes.
